rounds.text: Amtech Esters Ltd demonstrates exceptional capital efficiency, evidenced by an ROE of 24.49% and an ROCE of 28.3%, both of which significantly outperform their respective sector benchmarks of 8.26% and 10.29% [E8, E9]. The company maintains a robust balance sheet with a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.17x, while simultaneously reducing total borrowings from Rs 3.99 Cr to Rs 3.41 Cr [E22, E24]. Growth potential is supported by a 261.5% increase in capital work in progress, signaling a clear commitment to expanding productive capacity [E25]. Furthermore, the stock is currently trading at a discount to its intrinsic value of Rs 110 per share [E29]. Conceded: the dividend yield is 0.00% [E3], the stock sits at only 14% of its 52-week range [E4], and debtor days have increased from 76.4 to 91.9 days [E34]. Despite these headwinds, the company operates within a sector currently experiencing a positive tailwind, providing a supportive macro backdrop for its ongoing operations [E39, E40].
